title: Assertion-to-Evidence Ledger
description: Source of truth for evidence/assertion-to-evidence/ledger.md. Each instance records one artifact that asserted more than had been shown, who judged it so, and whether a human has confirmed the finding. The Markdown ledger is rendered from this file and never hand-edited.

countermeasures.description: Known countermeasures, so that ones with zero instances still appear in the tallies as not yet exercised.

readingNotes.description: Paragraphs rendered under the tallies. Interpretation that must travel with the counts.

confirmed.description: A human's label on the finding's quality. A row enters as unlabelled and stays so until a human reads it.

confirmedNote.description: Required context for yellow or red.

recorded.description: When the row was written, if later than found.

foundBy.description: Who judged the assertion unsupported: human, <runtime>:<session>, or unrecorded.

direction.description: never: the evidence was never produced. expired: it existed and stopped being true.

countermeasure.description: Entry from countermeasures, or none when no mechanism exists.

caughtNote.description: How a human found it first, or the caveat on a yes.

fixed.description: What was done, or open with a pointer.
